retro:
# Retrospective: PR 12815

## What worked

Verified fresh Fable High and Astra Xhigh sessions independently investigated equivalent neutral scope. Both used separate review.py plans, fixtures, homes and runtime boundaries. Root identity simulation, logged helper calls and individual baseline substitutions made the successful change clear without host mutation. No finding quota or speculative test advice was imposed. Full reports and material evidence were read before synthesis; original and diagnostic sources remained separate.

## Friction and improvements

Fable's first fixture hit a Bash local-variable initialization bug. The failed run was preserved, a corrected version produced complete evidence, and no failed setup was treated as a PR defect. Fable's broad differential shell-suite run consumed substantially more time than the focused guard checks and lacked Node in the sanitized PATH. For future broad suite claims, explicitly include the documented fixture-local Node binary or state the narrower scope from the start.

A pane snapshot suggested a long-running documentation command, but process inspection showed an active bounded isolated suite run. Lifecycle guidance was queued without interruption. Prefer owned process inspection before inferring a pager stall from display output.

## Tool status

No confirmed review.py or Omadev bug. No Omadev resources used. A private sandbox and fakeroot were sufficient. Read-only seals were verified independently during synthesis, but seals alone were not treated as test validity.

## Carry forward

For early-refusal changes, retain status, diagnostic text and zero-helper-call checks together, plus ordinary-user controls. An unchanged failing full suite is differential evidence only, not a complete pass. Keep public feedback short and limit it to demonstrated behavior and meaningful limitations.

## Cleanup

Both reviewers completed with private fixtures/runtimes torn down and no persistent test services. Worktrees, reports, fixtures and sealed runs are retained for audit. Team panes and native session history are preserved; no other team or Work resource was touched. HTML is saved only, publication delegated to the outer assistant.
comment:
**Verified:** No actionable issue found in the tested scope at `1bae00b0a13a235946614579357fb870b0436951`. Both setup commands now reject root before setup begins, with exit 1 and guidance to run as the desktop user.

Observed with fakeroot and mocked package, service and UI helpers:

| Command | Baseline as root | PR as root |
|---|---|---|
| Tailscale setup | Reaches setup helpers | Refuses; zero helper calls |
| SSH setup | Reaches setup helpers and prompt | Refuses; zero helper calls |

Ordinary-user helper sequences matched the baseline, and the existing mocked SSH setup tests passed. The new regression test passed at head and rejected either command independently restored to its unguarded baseline version.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Actual scripts with simulated root identity and mocked external effects. Live sudo, Tailscale authentication, services, firewall changes and remote SSH login were not exercised. The CLI suite passed; the full shell suite did not pass in this environment, with the same failed-file set on baseline and head.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra initial source inspection, independent Fable 5.1 and separate Astra technical reviews, followed by coordinator verification of claims against targeted source and execution evidence.
